items.name: Ability
items.definition: A hero action or persistent trait defined by packaged gameplay data. Abilities occupy basic, passive, random, or special loadout slots.

items.name: Basic Ability
items.definition: The hero's standard combat action in the basic loadout slot.

items.name: Class
items.definition: A hero's broad combat role: Sentinel, Ravager, or Tempest.

items.name: Cooldown
items.definition: The recovery period after an ability is used before it can be activated again.

items.name: Crogenitor Level
items.definition: The progression level used to determine when hero profiles become available.

items.name: Element
items.definition: A hero's genesis affinity. The archive preserves the content labels Cyber, Chrono, Bio, Plasma, and Necro.

items.name: Enemy
items.definition: A combat-capable non-player creature recovered from placed level nouns and class data.

items.name: Energy Damage
items.definition: One of corrupted's two broad damage channels. Abilities identify their authored damage channel separately from their elemental theme.

items.name: Genesis
items.definition: The in-game term for elemental affinity, used to group heroes and combat relationships.

items.name: Genetic Variant
items.definition: One of four profiles in a hero family: Alpha, Beta, Gamma, or Delta. Variants can change unlock level, statistics, and the variant ability.

items.name: Health
items.definition: A creature's remaining survivability. A hero or enemy is defeated when its health is exhausted.

items.name: Hero
items.definition: A playable genetic combatant with an element, class, statistics, equipment, and ability loadout.

items.name: Hero Family
items.definition: The archive grouping that combines a hero's four genetic variants into one dossier.

items.name: Item
items.definition: A piece of equipment used to improve a hero. The archive groups procedural item variations beneath a recovered base family.

items.name: Item Level
items.definition: The level attached to an equipment roll, used as a compact indication of that item's progression tier.

items.name: Level
items.definition: A playable or development area recovered from packaged level, chain, marker, and spawn data.

items.name: Locale Key
items.definition: A stable identifier used to look up authored text in corrupted's localization tables.

items.name: Noun
items.definition: corrupted's content term for a game object definition, including creatures, projectiles, pickups, and world objects.

items.name: Package
items.definition: A DBPF container from the corrupted client that stores typed game resources such as UI images, levels, scripts, and asset definitions.

items.name: Passive Ability
items.definition: An always-on or automatically triggered ability in the passive loadout slot.

items.name: Physical Damage
items.definition: One of corrupted's two broad damage channels, distinct from energy damage.

items.name: Power
items.definition: The resource spent to activate abilities. Packaged Lua registrations commonly call this value mana cost internally.

items.name: Prefix
items.definition: A procedural item-name component associated with one set of generated item modifiers.

items.name: Quantum
items.definition: The player-facing affinity name associated with quantum and spacetime powers. Some recovered content fields use the label Chrono.

items.name: Ravager
items.definition: One of the three hero classes, generally associated with aggressive close-range or mobile combat.

items.name: Rigblock
items.definition: A generated equipment record that joins a visual part, compatible affinities, and procedural item data.

items.name: Sentinel
items.definition: One of the three hero classes, generally associated with durability and defensive control.

items.name: Special Ability
items.definition: An activated hero ability occupying one of the two special loadout positions.

items.name: Squad
items.definition: A player-selected group of heroes used together during an expedition.

items.name: Status Effect
items.definition: A temporary gameplay condition that buffs, damages, controls, protects, or restricts a creature.

items.name: Suffix
items.definition: A procedural item-name component associated with an additional generated modifier.

items.name: Tempest
items.definition: One of the three hero classes, generally associated with ranged abilities and support or control.

items.name: Variant Ability
items.definition: The ability that changes between a hero family's Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta profiles. The archive labels this as the random slot.
